description: Cinematic high-end commercial for Ollimia Extra Virgin Olive Oil. The video starts with the camera orbiting a black opaque squeeze bottle of Ollimia olive oil (as provided in the reference image). Deep olive green background with warm studio backlighting. Whole fresh green Picual olives and olive tree leaves float in zero gravity slow-motion around the bottle. A golden ribbon stream of rich extra virgin olive oil pours continuously in slow motion, drizzling with surgical precision. Smooth dynamic camera orbital shots and macro close-ups highlight the sleek matte black squeeze bottle, the green label with 'Ollimia' branding, the smart twist-to-open nozzle, and glistening golden oil droplets.
style: cinematic, high-end commercial, ultra-realistic food photography, studio lighting
camera: continuous dynamic orbital shots, macro close-ups, smooth slow-motion panning
lighting: moody dark studio lighting with dramatic olive-green warm backlighting and soft golden highlights
room: abstract elegant dark studio void with subtle olive gradient background
elements: Ollimia squeeze bottle (black opaque bottle with olive green label, gold branding 'Ollimia', and black nozzle as shown in reference image)
fresh green Picual olives floating in slow motion with droplets of oil
olive branches and leaves spinning gently mid-air
golden stream of pure extra virgin olive oil pouring in slow-motion
glistening golden oil droplets suspended in mid-air
macro detail of smart twist-to-open nozzle dispensing a precise golden oil thread

timeline.action: Dramatically lit low-angle shot of the Ollimia squeeze bottle rising into frame against a dark olive backdrop, surrounded by floating green Picual olives and soft warm backlighting.
Camera performs a slow orbital rotation while macro close-up captures fresh green olives and leaves tumbling past in zero-gravity slow motion.
Two Ollimia squeeze bottles pass each other in opposite vertical movements while a continuous golden ribbon of extra virgin olive oil pours in slow motion.
Macro close-up shot of the smart twist-to-open nozzle dispensing a pristine, surgical golden stream of olive oil with zero dripping.
Final beauty shot of the Ollimia squeeze bottle centered on the left, while golden particles and 'OLLIMIA' brand typography subtly illuminate on the right.

motion: seamless, slow-motion liquid flow, rotating bottle, floating olives and leaves, elegant continuous camera trajectory without harsh cuts
ending: Pristine, hero shot of the Ollimia squeeze bottle on a dark olive textured studio background with golden oil droplets glistening around it
